comment: Literally the goat. Easy class, free A, you learn a lot. He cares a lot about you and your experience with guitar. Even if you don't play, you can rent a free guitar and just get a free A for half credit and get pretty good at the guitar. Would def. take this class if you have space in your schedule.

At first I was really struggling to learn guitar, but Prof. Harding encouraged me to stick with it. You will have to perform for the class but he was a very chill grader so it wasn't stressful. Cool guy with lots of musical knowledge and a love of the instrument.
He's awesome!
He's totally awesome. Great talented professor and a wholesome man. Inspired me to learn more about bossa nova and blues.

Awesomely nice, extremely interesting.  Had at least five kids (at W&M) come up to him and tell him it was the best class they had ever taken at the school and the end of class.  History of Jazz was difficult, but very possible to get an A.  Made the subject incredibly interesting.  Just a very "cool" guy. 100% recommended.

He won't shut up!!! Other than that, he's pretty cool and the class is interesting and engaging. 2 tests and 2 1-page papers. Easy A. I recommend the class to fulfill the gened requirement. He just talks SOOO much!

Most amazing teacher ever. He is extremely helpful and understanding of any problems or concerns.  Plus he is full of lame jokes and an endless amount of music knowledge.  Class is fun because he often rocks out for us on his guitar and sings.

Did a good job of making the class as bearable as possible for non-guitarists.  Almost always let us out early.  Extremely nice guy, and kind of funny too.  Glad he was my professor.  By the way, I was one of his VCU students.

I went from not being able to hold a guitar correctly, to playing the rhythm of my favorite songs in 8 class-hours. VCU class is only 30 min 1X a week, so I was all business when we met - however he was friendly and open to talk to.  If the two of you stay focused, & don't jam out, he has so much skill to teach.  Look forward to him next semester.
I LOVE KEVIN!!!!! HE'S AWESOMEEEEEEEEEE
